statement.en: Covering, comparing what courses keep reachable offset by offset, implies inclusion now, so only the lagged order puts a range that keeps widening above one wider now that starts a course, a verdict C leaves open. On a branching witness realized and reachable widening relate a pair oppositely.
statement.zh: 覆盖即逐偏移比较进程保持可达者，它蕴含当下之包含，故仅带滞后之序才把持续扩大的范围置于起进程且当下更宽者之上，此判定 C 不定。在一分支见证上，实现之扩大与可达之扩大于一对进程方向相反。

laws.en: Ranges of courses. A course's range includes another's where what the other admits at an offset it admits there; exceeding and widening as for levels. These are the grammar's inclusion and exceeding of what the courses admit as (offset, formation) claims, and with fixed conditions 07's inclusion and widening. Range inclusion is a preorder, range widening irreflexive and transitive.
laws.zh: 进程之范围。一进程之范围包含另一者，若后者于某偏移所纳，前者于该偏移亦纳；超出与扩大同水平之例。此即语法对进程所纳（偏移、构成）之包含与超出，条件固定时即 07 之包含与扩大。范围包含为预序，范围扩大非自反且传递。

laws.en: Covering and widening what can be reached. A configuration covers another where every course from the other is included by some course from it, and widens what can be reached over it where it covers it and some course from it is included by none from the other. Covering is a preorder; widening what can be reached is irreflexive and transitive, composes with covering on either side and is not covered back; no premise.
laws.zh: 覆盖与可达之扩大。一构型覆盖另一者，若后者出发之每一进程皆为前者出发之某进程所包含；若覆盖之且前者出发之某进程不为后者出发之任何进程所包含，则扩大可达者。覆盖为预序；可达之扩大非自反、传递，两侧皆与覆盖相合，且不被反向覆盖；无前提。

laws.en: Covering implies inclusion now: a configuration covering one that starts a course admits now all it admits now; the converse fails (WiderNow), and one starting no course is covered by every configuration. So where s' starts a course and admits now what s does not, s does not widen what can be reached over s', nor, the realized courses starting at their configurations, is s above s' in the lexical order.
laws.zh: 覆盖蕴含当下之包含：覆盖一起进程之构型者，当下纳后者当下所纳之一切；当下之包含不给出覆盖（WiderNow 上），不起进程之构型为每一构型所覆盖。故 s' 起进程且当下纳 s 所不纳时，s 不扩大可达者于 s' 之上；实现之进程起于其构型时，于字典序中 s 亦不在 s' 之上。

laws.en: Witness EndsNow: some n climbs, admitting the formations up to n; none has no step and admits every formation. What the climb from some 0 admits keeps widening, none admits now what it does not, and some 0 widens what can be reached over none, which starts no course: the premise that the configuration wider now starts a course is needed.
laws.zh: 见证 EndsNow：some n 攀升，纳至 n 之构成；none 无步而纳每一构成。自 some 0 之攀升所纳持续扩大，none 当下纳其所不纳，而 some 0 扩大可达者于不起进程之 none 之上：当下更宽之构型起进程之前提不可少。

laws.en: Greatest courses and determined processes. Where each configuration has a course including every course from it, widening what can be reached is the strict part of range inclusion of those courses; such a course can exist where courses differ. Where any two courses from one configuration agree, as for a determined law, every course is greatest, so it is the strict part of range inclusion of the two courses.
laws.zh: 最大进程与决定性过程。每一构型皆有包含其出发之每一进程者时，可达之扩大即这些进程之范围包含的严格部分；进程不一时亦可有此进程。同一构型出发之任二进程一致时（如决定性律），每一进程皆最大，故即两进程范围包含之严格部分。

laws.en: Covering with a lag: every course from the other is included d offsets later by a course from it, UE9's inclusion with a lag read on courses; lag 0 is covering and lags add. Widening with a lag is covering with some lag and covered back with none; joined to widening what can be reached as UE9 joins its orders, it is a strict partial order putting no configuration above one covering it, so never reversing widening.
laws.zh: 带滞后之覆盖：后者出发之每一进程皆于 d 个偏移之后为前者出发之某进程所包含，即 UE9 之带滞后包含读于进程；滞后 0 即覆盖，滞后相加。带滞后之扩大即以某滞后覆盖而不被反向覆盖；如 UE9 合其序那样并入可达之扩大，得一严格偏序，从不把构型置于覆盖它者之上，故从不逆转扩大。

laws.en: On a determined process covering with lag d is inclusion with lag d of the two courses, and the lagged order is the strict part of their range inclusion joined to the strict part of their inclusion with some lag. Along a course widening with a lag never puts a configuration above its predecessor, so the lagged order puts a successor above it exactly where same-offset widening does.
laws.zh: 决定性过程上，滞后 d 之覆盖即两进程滞后 d 之包含，滞后之序即其范围包含之严格部分并入其某滞后包含之严格部分。沿一进程，带滞后之扩大从不把构型置于其前驱之上，故滞后之序把后继置于前驱之上，恰在同偏移之扩大如此之处。

laws.en: Witness WiderNow, a determined law: none stays, admitting formations 0 and 1; some n climbs, admitting those up to n. What the climb from some 0 admits keeps widening, none admits now what it does not, and each course exceeds the other; same-offset widening and the lexical order are silent both ways, and the lagged order puts the climb above none and not conversely.
laws.zh: 见证 WiderNow，决定性律：none 停留，纳构成 0 与 1；some n 攀升，纳至 n 者。自 some 0 之攀升所纳持续扩大，none 当下纳其所不纳，二进程互相超出；同偏移之扩大与字典序两向皆默，滞后之序把攀升置于 none 之上而非反之。

laws.en: On WiderNow's process, with none admitting one side's first formation and every formation of the other, each course exceeds the other and the lagged order is silent both ways; with none admitting every formation, it puts none above the climb, as it must. Widening what can be reached and the lagged order satisfy C on the frame of reachable ranges and differ on WiderNow: the lag's verdict is a premise beyond C.
laws.zh: WiderNow 之过程上，none 纳一侧之首构成与另一侧之每一构成时，二进程互相超出而滞后之序两向皆默；none 纳每一构成时，它把 none 置于攀升之上，理当如此。可达之扩大与滞后之序皆于可达范围之框上满足 C，而于 WiderNow 上相异：滞后之判定是 C 之外之前提。

laws.en: The possible. The whole possible from s is what some configuration reachable from s admits; the possible within k, what some configuration reached in at most k steps admits. They are realizability of the one-formation bundle within some bound and within k moves (Labelled's WithinMoves). The possible within a horizon is possible, grows with the horizon and contains the present.
laws.zh: 可能者。自 s 之全部可能，即自 s 可达之某构型所纳；k 内之可能，即至多 k 步所达之某构型所纳。二者即单一构成之束于某界内、于 k 步内可实现（Labelled 之 WithinMoves）。一视界内之可能皆可能，随视界增大，且含当下。

laws.en: Nothing is added to the whole possible along a course: what is possible from a reachable configuration is possible from the first (from together_after_reach), so from no later configuration of a course is anything new possible; a step losing a possibility has no way back (from lost_together_not_returns); what is possible within k of the next configuration is possible within k + 1 of the present one.
laws.zh: 沿一进程全部可能无所增：自可达构型可能者自起点亦可能（出自 together_after_reach），故进程之后续构型无一新者可能；失去一可能之步无回路（出自 lost_together_not_returns）；自下一构型 k 内可能者，自当下 k + 1 内亦可能。

laws.en: Covering carries the possible where courses exist. A trace into a course's start gives a course whose states from some step on are the other's (the strong form of Onward.run_of_trace). So where every configuration reachable from s' starts a course, a configuration covering s' has all that is possible from it, and a step whose later configuration covers the earlier leaves the whole possible unchanged.
laws.zh: 进程存在处覆盖承载可能。进入一进程起点之迹给出一进程，其自某步起之状态即后者之状态（Onward.run_of_trace 之强形式）。故自 s' 可达之每一构型皆起进程时，覆盖 s' 之构型有自其可能之一切；后一构型覆盖前者之步令全部可能不变。

laws.en: Witness NoCourse: true stays, admitting nothing; false has no step and admits every formation. Covering reads infinite courses only, so true widens what can be reached over false, which starts no course, while everything is possible from false and nothing from true: covering carrying the possible needs its premise.
laws.zh: 见证 NoCourse：true 停留，无所纳；false 无步而纳每一构成。覆盖只读无穷进程，故 true 扩大可达者于不起进程之 false 之上，而自 false 一切皆可能、自 true 无一可能：覆盖承载可能需其前提。

laws.en: The rise. With a lag of one step each configuration of a course covers its successor; on a determined process the next configuration widens what can be reached over the present one exactly when the course one step on strictly includes the course. On Rise's rising step it rises while the whole possible and the possible within each horizon past the present stay the same.
laws.zh: 上升。滞后一步时，进程之每一构型覆盖其后继；决定性过程上，下一构型扩大可达者于当下者之上，恰当后移一步之进程严格包含进程本身。Rise 之上升步上，可达之扩大上升，而全部可能及当下以外每一视界内之可能皆不变。

laws.en: Keeping widening needs an unlisted range. A chain keeps widening (07's form) where nothing held is lost and after every step something not held is held later; it gathers n distinct members at one step for every n, so no list holds it. Along a course the possible within k does not keep widening where a list holds it or the whole possible. By name, keeping widening is exactly such a chain, which gives its law by name.
laws.zh: 持续扩大需无列表之范围。一链持续扩大，若所持无一后失，且每步之后有未持者后被持，即自首步起之 07 形式；它对每一 n 于一步聚 n 个不同成员，故无列表持之。沿一进程，有列表持 k 内之可能或全部可能时，k 内之可能不持续扩大。按名持续扩大恰为此种链，由之得其按名之律。

laws.en: Witnesses. On Climb, the determined law of the successor with n admitting the formations up to n, the possible within every horizon keeps widening and no list holds the whole possible. The converse fails: from AllAtOnce's one configuration, admitting every formation, no list holds the whole possible, and along no course does the possible within any horizon keep widening.
laws.zh: 见证。Climb 为后继之决定性律，n 纳至 n 之构成，其上每一视界内之可能持续扩大，无列表持全部可能。其逆不成立：AllAtOnce 之唯一构型纳每一构成，无列表持全部可能，而沿任一进程，无一视界内之可能持续扩大。

laws.en: Witness KeptAlternative. E's course runs through configurations admitting formations 0 and 1. From k two branches: the realized one admits 0, a wide one not realized admits at each later step t the formations up to t + 1; from single only the realized one; k and single admit 0 and 1. The realized course from each configuration starts there; the wide branch includes every course from k, though courses from k differ.
laws.zh: 见证 KeptAlternative。E 之进程经过纳构成 0 与 1 之构型。自 k 有二分支：实现者纳 0，未实现之宽分支于其后每一步 t 纳至 t + 1 者；自 single 仅实现者；k 与 single 纳 0 与 1。各构型之实现进程起于该处；宽分支包含自 k 之每一进程，虽自 k 之进程不一。

laws.en: Realized and reachable widening hold of a pair in opposite directions, on this witness: E's realized course widens k's, while k widens what can be reached over E through its course not realized; so no strict partial order contains both, nor satisfies C on both the realized courses and the reachable ranges. On a determined process, with realized courses starting at their configurations, realized widening gives reachable widening.
laws.zh: 于此见证上，实现之扩大与可达之扩大于一对进程方向相反：E 之实现进程扩大 k 者，而 k 经未实现之进程扩大可达者于 E 之上；故无严格偏序兼含二者，亦无一既于实现进程上又于可达范围上满足 C。决定性过程上，实现之进程起于其构型时，实现之扩大给出可达之扩大。

laws.en: The lexical order, realized widening or the same realized range and widening what can be reached, is a strict partial order containing realized widening and never reversing it. It lies inside the two-tier lexical order read on realized claims, then reachable ranges, which gives it back where inclusions are decided. It puts k above single, with the same realized ranges, a pair realized widening leaves undecided.
laws.zh: 字典序：实现之扩大，或实现范围相同而扩大可达者，为包含实现之扩大且从不逆转之的严格偏序。它位于本包之二层字典序之内（先读实现之断言，再读可达范围）；包含可判定时二层之序给回它。它把 k 置于 single 之上，二者实现范围相同，实现之扩大于此不定。

laws.en: Covering is the lower (Hoare) preorder of the families of course ranges: inclusion of the ranges some course includes, dominance for every criterion on ranges closed upward under inclusion, and carrying the profiles of the courses on the frame of courses, so preserving every bundle of their (offset, formation) admissions.
laws.zh: 覆盖是进程范围之族的下（Hoare）预序：某进程所包含之范围的包含，对范围上每一向上封闭于包含之判据的支配，且于进程之框上承载进程之轮廓，故保持其（偏移、构成）所纳之每一束。

laws.en: Widening what can be reached is extension, every claim living, on the frame of reachable ranges, both ways and with no premise; so C read on reachable ranges is Comparison (Reaching.reachFrame P adm) (fun _ => True), a definition.
laws.zh: 可达之扩大即可达范围之框上的延展（每一断言皆活），两向且无前提；故读于可达范围之 C 即 Comparison (Reaching.reachFrame P adm) (fun _ => True)，乃一定义。

laws.en: Witness DeferredBranching: late steps to mid, which steps to a or to b; early steps at once to ma or to mb, which step to a and to b. late and early cover each other, yet one step on the next configuration of every course from late widens what can be reached over that of every course from early; late simulates early, and no simulation relates late to early. Covering cannot see when a commitment is made.
laws.zh: 见证 DeferredBranching：late 步至 mid，mid 步至 a 或 b；early 即步至 ma 或 mb，二者分别步至 a 与 b。late 与 early 互相覆盖，然一步之后，自 late 之每一进程的下一构型扩大可达者于自 early 者之上；late 模拟 early，而无模拟把 late 关联于 early。覆盖看不见承诺何时作出。

laws.en: Witness KeptTogether: both stays; split steps to zero or to one, each staying. The two have the same whole possible and the same bundles realizable within every bound, yet both widens what can be reached over split: a course from both holds the two formations at every offset, each from split only at its start. So here no irreflexive comparison of descriptions the bundles determine satisfies C on reachable ranges.
laws.zh: 见证 KeptTogether：both 停留；split 步至 zero 或 one，各自停留。二者全部可能相同，每一界内可共同实现之束亦同，然 both 扩大可达者于 split 之上：自 both 之一进程于每一偏移共持二构成，自 split 之每一进程仅于起点共持。故于此读自这些束所定之描述、不比较任一描述与自身之比较，无一于可达范围上满足 C。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Each law holds on every process with what each configuration admits given, or on a witness; inclusion now and the laws on it take the configuration wider now to start a course, covering carrying the possible takes every configuration reachable from the covered one to start one, and the laws on realized courses take each to start at its configuration.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。每一律于每一过程（各构型所纳给定）或于一见证上成立；当下之包含及其上之律需当下更宽之构型起进程；覆盖承载可能，需自被覆盖者可达之每一构型皆起进程；关于实现进程之律需其起于其构型。

hypotheses.en: Modelling choices: discrete steps; courses are infinite runs, so a configuration starting no course is covered by every configuration; the possible reads finite traces; courses compared at the same offsets, or with one lag for every offset; formations compared by name over one fixed type; one fixed process; the realized course a function on configurations.
hypotheses.zh: 建模之选：离散之步；进程为无穷之运行，故不起进程之构型为每一构型所覆盖；可能者读有穷之迹；进程按同一偏移比较，或每一偏移同一滞后；构成在一固定类型上按名比较；一个固定过程；实现之进程为构型之函数。

does_not_show.en: That the lagged order, the lexical order or any order here is the second-order direction of 生生 or ranks a course better: ranking needs C or a premise in its place, and the lag's verdict, which C leaves open, or a rule of precedence is a further premise.
does_not_show.zh: 滞后之序、字典序或此处任一序即生生的二阶方向或把进程排得更好：排序需要 C 或一个代替它的前提，而 C 不定之滞后判定或优先之规则是又一前提。

does_not_show.en: That read with a lag covering decides every pair of a range that keeps widening and one wider now that starts a course: it decides one witness's pair, and on another, each course exceeding the other, it is silent both ways.
does_not_show.zh: 带滞后读时覆盖判定每一持续扩大之范围与起进程且当下更宽者之对：它判定一见证之对，于另一处（二进程互相超出）两向皆默。

does_not_show.en: That the lagged order is UE9's: it is built as UE9's is, on families of courses, and UE9's laws on its order (names read across steps, the conflict with eventual widening) are not proved of it.
does_not_show.zh: 滞后之序即 UE9 之序：它如 UE9 之序那样构于进程之族，UE9 关于其序之律（跨步读名、与最终扩大之冲突）未对其证明。

does_not_show.en: A branching witness for keeping the possible within a horizon widening: Rise, Climb and WiderNow are determined, so on them every notion here is a property of single courses.
does_not_show.zh: 一视界内之可能持续扩大之分支见证：Rise、Climb 与 WiderNow 皆决定性，其上此处每一概念皆单一进程之性质。

does_not_show.en: Anything about learning or quasi-option value: covering cannot see when a commitment is made.
does_not_show.zh: 关于学习或准选择价值之任何结论：覆盖看不见承诺何时作出。

does_not_show.en: The adjacent possible that cannot be prestated, or a process that changes itself: one process, one type of formations and one reading are fixed.
does_not_show.zh: 不可预先陈述之邻近可能，或自我改变之过程：一个过程、一种构成类型与一种读法皆固定。

does_not_show.en: Anything about what carries a course's openings, 07's remaining candidate.
does_not_show.zh: 关于承载进程之开出者（07 余下之候选）之任何结论。

does_not_show.en: A result no neighbouring field states: covering is the lower preorder, and the irreversibility premise and the pigeonhole of finite recurrence are restated; each law is near-definitional or a witness.
does_not_show.zh: 近邻领域无人陈述的结果：覆盖即下预序，不可逆前提与有限复现之鸽巢原理为重述；每一律近乎定义或为见证。

detail.en: Same-offset covering is silent on a climb that keeps widening against a configuration wider now (WiderNow.silent), which the lagged order decides (WiderNow.decided).
detail.zh: 同偏移之覆盖对持续扩大之攀升与当下更宽之构型沉默（WiderNow.silent），滞后之序判定之（WiderNow.decided）。

detail.en: With other admissions on the same process, each course exceeding the other, the lagged order is silent both ways (WiderNow.TwoSided.silent); where the configuration wider now also widens what can be reached over the climb, it puts that configuration above (WiderNow.Full.not_silent).
detail.zh: 同一过程上换一种所纳，二进程互相超出，滞后之序两向皆默（WiderNow.TwoSided.silent）；当下更宽之构型亦扩大可达者于攀升之上时，它把该构型置于其上（WiderNow.Full.not_silent）。

detail.en: Where the configuration wider now starts no course, a climb that keeps widening widens what can be reached over it (EndsNow.keeps_widening_above_wider_now).
detail.zh: 当下更宽之构型不起进程时，持续扩大之攀升扩大可达者于其上（EndsNow.keeps_widening_above_wider_now）。

detail.en: Inclusion now does not give covering (WiderNow.inclusion_now_not_covering).
detail.zh: 当下之包含不给出覆盖（WiderNow.inclusion_now_not_covering）。

detail.en: A configuration starting no course is covered by every configuration, and one from which nothing is possible widens what can be reached over it, everything being possible from it (NoCourse.widens_reversed).
detail.zh: 不起进程之构型为每一构型所覆盖，且自其无一可能之构型扩大可达者于其上，而自其一切皆可能（NoCourse.widens_reversed）。

detail.en: Same-offset widening of what can be reached rises along a course while the whole possible stays the same (Rise.rises, Rise.possible_same).
detail.zh: 同偏移之可达扩大沿一进程上升，而全部可能不变（Rise.rises、Rise.possible_same）。

detail.en: From one configuration admitting every formation no list holds the whole possible, and the possible within no horizon keeps widening (AllAtOnce.converse_fails).
detail.zh: 自纳每一构成之唯一构型，无列表持全部可能，而无一视界内之可能持续扩大（AllAtOnce.converse_fails）。

detail.en: E's realized course widens k's while k widens what can be reached over E (KeptAlternative.disagree).
detail.zh: E 之实现进程扩大 k 者，而 k 扩大可达者于 E 之上（KeptAlternative.disagree）。

detail.en: Two configurations with the same whole possible and the same bundles within every bound differ in what can be reached (KeptTogether.same_bundles, KeptTogether.widens).
detail.zh: 全部可能相同、每一界内之束亦同之二构型，其可达者不同（KeptTogether.same_bundles、KeptTogether.widens）。

detail.en: late and early cover each other while only late simulates early (DeferredBranching.cover_both, DeferredBranching.early_not_simulating_late).
detail.zh: late 与 early 互相覆盖，而仅 late 模拟 early（DeferredBranching.cover_both、DeferredBranching.early_not_simulating_late）。

next_delta.en: What carries a course's openings, 07's remaining candidate; a branching witness for keeping the possible within a horizon widening; a reason, or a premise, for a rule of precedence between realized and reachable widening, or for a lag's verdict; review by a person.
next_delta.zh: 承载进程之开出者，07 余下之候选；一视界内之可能持续扩大之分支见证；实现与可达之扩大间优先规则或滞后之理由或前提；人之审查。

correspondence.en: Covering is the lower (Hoare) preorder of the families of course ranges, exactly dominance for every criterion closed upward under inclusion; read by the AI, the unanimous ordinal form of a preference for flexibility (Kreps 1979). With options unordered it is the inclusion opportunity-set rankings share (Jones and Sugden 1982; Bossert, Pattanaik and Xu 1994) and Foster's effective freedom with every preference admitted (1993; 2011), while Pattanaik and Xu (1990) count options. Nothing added to the whole possible is the irreversibility premise of Arrow and Fisher (1974) and Henry (1974); quasi-option value, needing learning and deferral, is not captured, covering being linear-time (van Glabbeek 1990). The possible within a horizon restates Kauffman's adjacent possible (2000) for a prestated space, not the one that cannot be prestated (Longo, Montévil and Kauffman 2012); no listed range keeping widening is the pigeonhole of finite recurrence, with the open-ended evolution papers (Bedau and others 2000; Taylor and others 2016; Adams and others 2017) as neighbours. The lexical order is the two-tier order, near Sen's achievement and freedom (1985); assembly theory is an analogy. Graded in UE10's NOTE, REVIEW-UE10 and RECHECK-UE10.
correspondence.zh: 覆盖是进程范围之族的下（Hoare）预序，恰为对每一向上封闭于包含之判据的支配；依 AI 之读，即偏好灵活性之一致序形式（Kreps 1979）。选项无序时即机会集排序共有之包含（Jones 与 Sugden 1982；Bossert、Pattanaik 与 Xu 1994），亦即 Foster 的有效自由在容纳一切偏好时的情形（1993；2011），Pattanaik 与 Xu（1990）则计选项。全部可能无所增即 Arrow 与 Fisher（1974）及 Henry（1974）之不可逆前提；准选择价值需学习与延迟，未被捕捉，覆盖为线性时间（van Glabbeek 1990）。视界内之可能为预先陈述之空间重述 Kauffman 之邻近可能（2000），非不可预先陈述者（Longo、Montévil 与 Kauffman 2012）；无列表之范围持续扩大即有限复现之鸽巢原理，开放式演化诸文为近邻。字典序即二层之序，近 Sen 之成就与自由（1985）；组装理论为类比。分级见 UE10 之 NOTE、REVIEW-UE10 与 RECHECK-UE10。

detail.en: The lagged order is built as its widening or widening with a lag is, on families of courses, and covering with a lag reads Web.IncludesLater on courses; the module does not import it.
detail.zh: 滞后之序如其带滞后或不带之扩大那样构于进程之族，带滞后之覆盖把 Web.IncludesLater 读于进程；本模块不引入之。

detail.en: Web.KeepsWidening and Web.KeepsWidening.not_listed: the chain law reads the first both ways (Web.keepsWidening_iff_chain) and re-derives the second (Web.KeepsWidening.not_listed_via_chain).
detail.zh: Web.KeepsWidening 与 Web.KeepsWidening.not_listed：链之律双向读前者（Web.keepsWidening_iff_chain），并重新推出后者（Web.KeepsWidening.not_listed_via_chain）。

detail.en: WithinMoves, withinMoves_iff_reach, together_after_reach, lost_together_not_returns and WithinMoves.before: the possible as realizability of one formation, and nothing added from them.
detail.zh: WithinMoves、withinMoves_iff_reach、together_after_reach、lost_together_not_returns 与 WithinMoves.before：可能者即单一构成之可实现，全部可能无所增出自它们。

detail.en: Onward.run_of_trace, Onward.reach_of_run, Run.reach and Run.cons: courses built by prefixing.
detail.zh: Onward.run_of_trace、Onward.reach_of_run、Run.reach 与 Run.cons：以前缀构建进程。

detail.en: Extension, Comparison, Comparison.separates and carries_iff_preserves: widening what can be reached as extension, C read on reachable ranges, and the separation by bundles.
detail.zh: Extension、Comparison、Comparison.separates 与 carries_iff_preserves：可达之扩大即延展，读于可达范围之 C，及以束之分离。

detail.en: CarriesProfiles and Lexical.Above: covering as carrying profiles, and the two-tier order the lexical order lies inside.
detail.zh: CarriesProfiles 与 Lexical.Above：覆盖即承载轮廓，及字典序所居之二层之序。

detail.en: Web.Includes and Web.Widens, which range inclusion and widening are with fixed conditions.
detail.zh: Web.Includes 与 Web.Widens，条件固定时范围包含与扩大即此。

detail.en: Dependence.AdmitsAt, Dependence.along and Conditions, through which a dependence gives what each configuration admits.
detail.zh: Dependence.AdmitsAt、Dependence.along 与 Conditions，由之一依赖给出各构型所纳。

detail.en: length_le_of_sub, the pigeonhole of the chain law.
detail.zh: length_le_of_sub，链之律之鸽巢原理。

detail.en: «际» and «则», the grammar's relation and inclusion, which range inclusion is.
detail.zh: «际» 与 «则»，语法之关系与包含，范围包含即此。

detail.en: «逾», the grammar's exceeding, which range exceeding is.
detail.zh: «逾»，语法之超出，范围超出即此。

detail.en: Its lagged order, built again on families of courses, decides one witness's pair where same-offset covering is silent; admitted ranges carry no alternatives, which covering adds.
detail.zh: 其滞后之序重构于进程之族，判定同偏移之覆盖沉默之一见证之对；所纳范围不带替代，覆盖添之。

detail.en: Eventual widening's second order: covering implies inclusion now, so what a course keeps reachable puts a range that keeps widening above one wider now that starts a course only read with a lag, and not every such pair.
detail.zh: 最终扩大之二阶：覆盖蕴含当下之包含，故进程保持可达者仅带滞后读时把持续扩大之范围置于起进程且当下更宽者之上，且非每一此种对。

detail.en: What one course keeping widening needs; here the possible within a horizon keeping widening needs an unlisted range, by the same pigeonhole.
detail.zh: 一个持续扩大的进程需要什么；此处一视界内之可能持续扩大需无列表之范围，同一鸽巢原理。

detail.en: C read as widening; widening what can be reached is C's extension on the frame of reachable ranges, and no order here is adopted by C.
detail.zh: 读作扩大的 C；可达之扩大即 C 于可达范围之框上之延展，此处无一序为 C 所采。

detail.en: Where the possible grows: its third law read on a part held, a rule changing its own rule and a tower of rules with no top; the possible relative to what is held grows only where what is held changes.
detail.zh: 可能者于何处增长：其第三律读于持守之部分、改变自身规则之规则与无顶之规则塔；相对于所持守者之可能仅于所持守者改变处增长。

detail.en: Tasks and what performs them: lagged covering extended from a step to reach, so a delivery adds nothing to the whole possible, and on what a configuration reaches the lagged order is same-offset widening, which follows deliveries in neither direction.
detail.zh: 任务与执行之者：滞后覆盖自一步推至可达，故交付不给全部可能增添任何东西；于一构型所达者上，滞后之序即同偏移之扩大，其于两向皆不随交付。

detail.en: What can be born next against what continues: on causal-set growth, including what can be born next at the same offsets is having precedence included, and every course from a causal set keeps widening it.
detail.zh: 次可生者与相续：于因果集之生长上，于同偏移处含次可生者即先后被含，自因果集起之每一历程皆使之不断扩大。

history.en: 27 October 2026: added (UE10), what a course keeps reachable: covering implies inclusion now, so it never ranks a configuration above one that starts a course and admits now what it does not; the lagged order on families of courses decides one witness's pair, not every such pair, a verdict C leaves open; nothing is added to the whole possible along a course; realized and reachable widening rank a pair oppositely on a branching witness; covering is the lower preorder; near-definitional; after a review and two re-checks; study section 424.
history.zh: 2026年10月27日：新增（UE10），进程保持可达者：覆盖蕴含当下之包含，故从不把一构型排在起进程且当下纳其所不纳者之上；进程之族上之滞后之序判定一见证之对，非每一此种对，此判定 C 不定；沿一进程全部可能无所增；在一分支见证上实现与可达之扩大对一对排序相反；覆盖即下预序；近乎定义；经审查与两次复查；研究第 424 节。

history.en: 3 November 2026, CD (board item CD): the statement says that only the lagged order puts a range that keeps widening above one wider now that starts a course, and that realized and reachable widening relate a pair oppositely, not that they rank it; laws 3, 6 to 9, 18 and 19, two counterexamples and a related line say likewise what widening what can be reached, widening with a lag, the lagged order and the lexical order do with a pair, as its home section in 07 §2 does. Under the glossary's one sense, ranking and order (the ethics' role word) say which course is better, and widening says which admits more, with no premise; an order defined with no premise, the lagged, tail or lexical order among them, puts one course above another, and ranks only where it is read as a ranking, in C's slot or as a premise. The claim is unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年11月3日，工作板条目 CD：陈述改说仅带滞后之序才把持续扩大之范围置于起进程且当下更宽者之上，且实现之扩大与可达之扩大于一对进程方向相反，而非对之排序；律 3、6 至 9、18 与 19，两个反例与一条相关说明亦改说可达之扩大、带滞后之扩大、滞后之序与字典序于一对进程何为，与 07 §2 的本节相同。按词汇表的单一词义，排序与次序（伦理的角色词）说哪个进程更好，扩大说哪个所纳更多，不需前提；无前提而定义之序（滞后之序、尾序或字典序等）把一进程置于另一进程之上，唯作为排序读时（于 C 之位或作为前提）才排序。主张不变。

history.zh: 2026年11月6日，看板项 CW：对应中加入 Foster 的有效自由，文献核对发现此已具名结果被遗漏；规律未变。

history.en: 7 November 2026, board item LM1: this said ranking needs C, where a ranking of courses needs C or a premise in its place (07 §4); corrected. No law, premise or proof changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月7日，工作板条目 LM1：此处谓排序须 C，而对进程的排序需要 C 或一个代替它的前提（07 §4）；已更正。诸律、前提与证明皆不变。
